name: vmd-mdanalysis-viz
description: Headless molecular visualization and trajectory analysis with VMD, MDAnalysis, and GROMACS. Use this skill when Claude needs to: (1) Render proteins/molecules (cartoon, licorice, VDW, surface) headlessly via vmd-python or VMD text mode, (2) Analyze MD trajectories (RMSD, RMSF, radius of gyration, hydrogen bonds, SASA, secondary structure, contacts), (3) Work with PDB/GRO/PSF/XTC/DCD/TRR structure and trajectory formats, (4) Drive GROMACS command-line analysis tools and parse XVG output.

findings.excerpt: echo "1 1" | gmx rms -s topol.tpr -f traj.xtc -o rmsd.xvg
- **MDAnalysis import error**: ensure installed: `pip install MDAnalysis`
